Whether a Form 8332 signed after the custodial parent claimed the children and produced only during examination satisfies the sec. 152(e)(2)(B) attachment requirement (held: no, for a paper return where the custodial parent never relinquished the claim)
Whether a July 2015 notarized statement attached to a proposed family court order is a sec. 152(e)(2)(A) declaration (held: no)
